facts.text: Wartburg College utilizes a 4-4-1 academic calendar for undergraduate students, dividing the academic year into two four-course terms (Fall and Winter) and one shorter, one-course May Term.

sources.title: Academic Calendar: Finals Schedule, Dates to Remember, Break Information | Wartburg College
sources.quote: Wartburg College utilizes a 4-4-1 academic calendar for undergraduate students. This means the academic year is divided into two four-course terms (Fall and Winter) and one shorter, one-course May Term.
